## Body

Copilot root assistant.turn_end and OMP turn_end close model/tool iterations, not agent work. Removing their idle posts must preserve real terminal events: Copilot session.idle, abort and fusion_completed; OMP agent_end without continuation; both shutdown repairs. Inspect downstream busy/idle consumers rather than assuming they need per-tool pulses.

F207 deliberately accepts a fresh target-seat memory.note even before prompt delivery settles: it is live-only and seat-filtered, not prompt-ID correlated. Idle arms a settle deadline, working cancels it, later idle restarts it, and the original hold bound caps the wait. The turn-end reading is policy; settle is a brake; note grace is authorization.

Do not overclaim security proof. Grace does not add a held-role allowlist: memory writes already permitted never-held role targets. Its broad fallback after identity refusal merits a same-pane rollover regression, but OMP /new updates PIJ_SESSION_ID; an old in-flight CLI may legitimately be the predecessor writing its final note. The initial proposed misattribution finding was withdrawn for lack of a normal-use trigger (C33/C34). An unsupported-verb negative test proves parsing refusal, not authorization for a different valid verb.
